title: Ɓeen Ɓooyɓe Alkawal Egguɓe
intro: E yontaaji gadani renndo ɓuuɓngo, leñol meeɗiino wuurde e nder galleeji tiiɗɗi, jokkondirɗi e nanondiral. Ndeen nanondiral janfaa, batte mum njiyti ko e kelle Quraana. Hol ɓeeɗoo yimɓe, hol ko woni galleeji maɓɓe e gese maɓɓe ?
clues: Min njooɗii e cuuɗi tiiɗɗi ɗi ndokki min kisal fenaande.
En ngonnoo ko yimɓe Binndi, kono en mbonnii aadi men.
Min pelliti nelaaɗo oo caggal nde o ari e amen, kono peeje amen ndartiima.
Palɗe men taƴaa ko e yamiroore Alla ko maande baawɗemakko.
Min ndiiwaa e galleeji amen, min ngartataa, ko jukkungo ngam salaade min.
Qur’aana siftorii en nder suura mooɓgal, habaru men ɗon laara jeertinaango ngam ƴamooɓe alkawal.

trial.answer: Siige e riiwtude ɓe e galleeji maɓɓe

options: Egguɓe e jawdi mum en ƴettaa
Woni ko ñawu nguu fiyi ɗum en
outcome.answer: Egguɓe e jawdi mum en ƴettaa

arabic: مَا قَطَعْتُم مِّن لِّينَةٍ أَوْ تَرَكْتُمُوهَا قَآئِمَةً عَلَىٰٓ أُصُولِهَا فَبِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِيُخْزِىَ ٱلْفَـٰسِقِينَ
verse: Whatever you have cut down of [their] palm trees or left standing on their trunks - it was by permission of Allāh and so He would disgrace the defiantly disobedient. (59:5)
